blocks.text: String theory theoretical physics ka ek advanced concept (khayal) hai jis ke mutabiq universe ke fundamental particles points (nuqte) nahi balke nanhe vibrating (thartharate) strings (dhaage) hain. Yeh strings khule ya band loops (chhalle) ho sakte hain, aur in ki vibration ka andaaz particle ki properties, jaise mass aur force, tay karta hai. String theory 'theory of everything' (har cheez ki ek theory) ban sakti hai, magar experiments se abhi tak prove nahi hui.

blocks.prompt: Quantum field theory aur string theory ka short comparison (muqabla) kijiye.

rows: Har particle kisi field ka quantum (packet) hai
Har particle ek nanhi vibrating string hai, point nahi
Forces boson field particles ke exchange se: photons, gluons, W aur Z, gravitons
String ki vibration ka andaaz particle ka mass aur force tay karta hai
Standard Model ki base; experiments se achhi tarah test ho chuki
Gravity samet 'theory of everything' banna chahti hai; experiments se abhi prove nahi

items: Quantum field theory: har particle ki quantum field; forces field quanta ke exchange se, sab bosons: photons (electromagnetic), gluons (strong), W aur Z (weak), gravitons (gravity).

String theory: particles nanhe vibrating khule ya band strings, jin ki vibration mass aur force tay karti hai; 'theory of everything' ki umeedwar, abhi prove nahi. Scale: molecule 10⁻⁹ m se quark (10⁻¹⁸ m se kam) tak.
